#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

class MCMF {
public:
    struct Edge {
        int to, flow, rev, cost;
        Edge(int a, int b, int c, int d) : to(a), flow(b), cost(c), rev(d) {}
    };

    vector<vector<Edge>> g;
    vector<vector<Edge>> mat;
    vector<int> pot;
    int N, S, T, maxFlow, minCost;
    const int INF = INT_MAX / 100;

    MCMF(int n, int s, int t) : N(n), S(s), T(t), maxFlow(0), minCost(0) {
        g.resize(N);
        pot.assign(N, 0);
    }

    void addEdge(int u, int v, int flow, int cost) {
        int lu = g[u].size(), lv = g[v].size();
        g[u].emplace_back(v, flow, cost, lv);
        g[v].emplace_back(u, 0, -cost, lu);
    }

    void toArray() {
        mat.resize(N);
        for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
            mat[i] = g[i];
            g[i].clear();
        }
    }

    bool bellmanFord(bool check) {
        pot[0] = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < N - 1; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < N; ++j) {
                for (const Edge& e : mat[j]) {
                    if (e.flow == 0) continue;
                    pot[e.to] = min(pot[e.to], pot[j] + e.cost);
                }
            }
        }
        if (check) {
            for (int j = 0; j < N; ++j) {
                for (const Edge& e : mat[j]) {
                    if (e.flow == 0) continue;
                    if (pot[j] + e.cost < pot[e.to]) return false;
                }
            }
        }
        return true;
    }

    vector<int> q;
    vector<int> vis;
    vector<int> prev, preve;
    vector<int> dist;

    bool simple() {
        q.assign(N, 0);
        vis.assign(N, 0);
        prev.assign(N, 0);
        preve.assign(N, 0);
        dist.assign(N, INF);
        q[0] = S;
        dist[0] = 0;
        int front = 1, back = 0;
        while (front != back) {
            int u = q[back++];
            if (back == N) back = 0;
            vis[u] = 2;
            for (int i = 0; i < (int)mat[u].size(); ++i) {
                Edge& e = mat[u][i];
                if (e.flow == 0) continue;
                int nd = dist[u] + e.cost;
                if (nd < dist[e.to]) {
                    if (vis[e.to] == 0) {
                        q[front] = e.to;
                        if (++front == N) front = 0;
                    } else if (vis[e.to] == 2) {
                        if (--back == -1) back += N;
                        q[back] = e.to;
                    }
                    vis[e.to] = 1;
                    preve[e.to] = i;
                    prev[e.to] = u;
                    dist[e.to] = nd;
                }
            }
        }
        return vis[T] != 0;
    }

    struct Pair {
        int f, s;
        Pair(int a, int b) : f(a), s(b) {}
        bool operator<(const Pair& other) const {
            return s > other.s; // min-heap
        }
    };

    bool dijkstra() {
        vis.assign(N, 0);
        prev.assign(N, 0);
        preve.assign(N, 0);
        dist.assign(N, INF);
        priority_queue<Pair> pq;
        pq.emplace(S, 0);
        dist[0] = 0;
        while (!pq.empty()) {
            Pair p = pq.top(); pq.pop();
            if (dist[p.f] < p.s) continue;
            vis[p.f] = 2;
            for (int i = 0; i < (int)mat[p.f].size(); ++i) {
                Edge& e = mat[p.f][i];
                if (e.flow == 0) continue;
                int nd = p.s + (e.cost + pot[p.f] - pot[e.to]);
                if (nd < dist[e.to]) {
                    if (vis[e.to] == 2) return false;
                    pq.emplace(e.to, nd);
                    dist[e.to] = nd;
                    prev[e.to] = p.f;
                    preve[e.to] = i;
                    vis[e.to] = 1;
                }
            }
        }
        return vis[T] != 0;
    }

    int augment() {
        int p = T, minf = INF;
        while (p != 0) {
            int pp = prev[p], pe = preve[p];
            minf = min(minf, mat[pp][pe].flow);
            p = pp;
        }
        p = T;
        while (p != 0) {
            int pp = prev[p], pe = preve[p];
            mat[pp][pe].flow -= minf;
            mat[p][mat[pp][pe].rev].flow += minf;
            p = pp;
        }
        maxFlow += minf;
        return minf;
    }

    bool calSimple() {
        while (simple()) {
            minCost += dist[T] * augment();
        }
        return true;
    }

    void updPot() {
        for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
            if (vis[i] != 0) {
                pot[i] += dist[i] - dist[S];
            }
        }
    }

    bool calWithPotential() {
        while (dijkstra()) {
            int minc = dist[T] + pot[T] - pot[S];
            minCost += minc * augment();
            updPot();
        }
        return true;
    }
};

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int n, m, k, c, d;
    cin >> n >> m >> k >> c >> d;
    int maxl = n + k;
    int T = n * maxl + 1;
    MCMF ans(T + 1, 0, T);

    vector<int> a(k + 1), f(n + 1, 0);
    for (int i = 1; i <= k; ++i) {
        cin >> a[i];
        f[a[i]]++;
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
        if (f[i] == 0) continue;
        ans.addEdge(0, i, f[i], 0);
    }
    for (int i = 2; i <= n; ++i) {
        for (int l = 0; l < maxl - 1; ++l) {
            ans.addEdge(l * n + i, (l + 1) * n + i, k, c);
        }
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; ++i) {
        int u, v;
        cin >> u >> v;
        for (int l = 0; l < maxl - 1; ++l) {
            for (int p = 1; p <= k; ++p) {
                if (u != 1)
                    ans.addEdge(n * l + u, n * (l + 1) + v, 1, d * (2 * p - 1) + c);
                if (v != 1)
                    ans.addEdge(n * l + v, n * (l + 1) + u, 1, d * (2 * p - 1) + c);
            }
        }
    }
    for (int l = 1; l < maxl; ++l) {
        ans.addEdge(l * n + 1, T, k, 0);
    }
    ans.toArray();
    ans.calSimple();
    if (ans.maxFlow != k) {
        cout << "BUG\n";
    } else {
        cout << (int)ans.minCost << "\n";
    }
    return 0;
}
